channel.title: Wire — DevOps

item.title: Terraform 1.16 completes Actions lifecycles and brings imports into child modules
item.description: Terraform 1.16 adds destroy-time Actions and reusable imports in child modules, keeping more infrastructure lifecycle operations in Terraform. (1 source: hashicorp)

item.title: Container Apps Express Reaches GA on a Newly Generally Available Sandbox Layer
item.description: Microsoft has made Azure Container Apps Express generally available alongside Container Apps Sandboxes, the microVM compute layer it runs on. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Presentation: Beyond Observability: Evolving Production Operations in the Age of AI
item.description: The panelists discuss how production operations are evolving with AI, turning operational data into actionable insights for incident response. (1 source: infoq)
